newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wharf Cable sees '98 operating breakeven.
newsitem.headline: Wharf Cable sees '98 operating breakeven.

text.p: Wharf (Holdings) Ltd said on Wednesday its Wharf Cable unit had achieved cost stablisation that it believed operating breakeven was attainable in 1998.
Wharf Cable's chairman Stephen Ng said in a statement the company had enjoyed a consistent expansion in subscriptions.
Subsciptions had grown consistently since 1995 at over 10,000 residential units a month to exceed 260,000.
The company is on course to exceed 300,000 subscibers by year-end, he said.

The Hong Kong government has extended the company's exclusive franchise for cable television services for a further two years and had decided to remove the advertising restrictions currently imposed on the company, he noted.
